label: ActivityGlassCamMain
does: The main camera screen: live preview, shutter, controls and settings.
notes: Host screen for all capture modes; tagged mode as the place modes are chosen

label: ActivityGlassCamMainSecure
does: Opens the camera from the lock screen without unlocking the phone.
notes: Secure (lock-screen) launch of the main camera

label: ActivityGlassCamShare
does: Lets another app ask GlassCam to take a photo and hands the result back.

label: ActivityGlassCamViewer
does: Gallery to browse, view and delete the photos and videos taken.

label: DngConvertingActivity
does: Converts raw files into DNG files the person can edit.

label: DngStackActivity
does: Merges several DNG frames into one stacked DNG.

label: VideoProfileEditorActivity
does: Screen to create and edit custom video profiles (resolution, fps, bitrate, codec).

label: PictureModuleApi2
does: Normal photo mode.

label: VideoModuleApi2
does: Video recording mode.

label: IntervalApi2
does: Interval/timelapse mode: takes a photo every set number of seconds.

label: AeBracketApi2
does: Exposure bracketing mode: several shots at different exposures in one press.

label: HuaweiAeBracketApi2
does: Exposure bracketing mode using Huawei's own bracketing support.

label: AfBracketApi2
does: Focus bracketing mode: several shots at different focus distances, for focus stacking.

label: PictureModuleMTK
does: Photo mode for MediaTek phones, including their raw capture path.
notes: Camera1, MediaTek devices only (SPEC: MTK raw path)

label: PictureModule
does: Normal photo mode on the older camera API.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2

label: IntervalModuleCamera1
does: Interval/timelapse mode on the older camera API.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2

label: VideoModuleG3
does: Video mode for LG phones using LG's own recorder.

label: VideoModule
does: Video recording mode on the older camera API.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2

label: BracketModule
does: Exposure bracketing mode on the older camera API.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2

label: camera_switch
does: Switches between the back and front camera (and other cameras).

label: self_timer
does: Sets a countdown before the photo is taken.

label: histogram
does: Shows a live histogram of brightness on the preview.

label: focuspeak
does: Highlights the sharp parts of the preview (focus peaking).

label: clipping
does: Marks over- and under-exposed areas on the preview (zebras).

label: histogram_stats_qcom
does: Shows a histogram computed by the camera hardware itself.
notes: Qualcomm vendor statistics; Camera2 only; duplicates HISTOGRAM's job via a different source

label: tone_curve_parameter
does: Opens a tone curve to shape contrast and brightness of the image.

label: focus_mode
does: Chooses the focus mode (auto, continuous, macro, manual, ...).

label: module
does: Switches capture mode (photo, video, interval, bracketing...).

label: exposure_lock
does: Locks the automatic exposure so it stops changing.

label: flash_mode
does: Sets the flash: off, on, auto or torch.

label: zoom
does: Zooms in and out.

label: focus
does: Sets focus distance by hand.

label: manual_iso
does: Sets ISO (sensor sensitivity) by hand.

label: exposure_time
does: Sets shutter speed by hand.

label: exposure_compensation
does: Makes the automatic exposure brighter or darker (EV).

label: aperture
does: Sets the lens aperture on phones with a variable aperture.
notes: Camera2; only phones with variable aperture

label: whitebalance
does: Sets white balance colour temperature by hand (Kelvin).

label: burst
does: Sets how many photos one shutter press takes (burst).

label: contrast
does: Sets image contrast.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2

label: brightness
does: Sets image brightness.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2

label: saturation
does: Sets colour saturation.

label: sharpness
does: Sets image sharpening.

label: zebra_high
does: Sets the brightness level above which zebras mark highlights as clipped.

label: zebra_low
does: Sets the brightness level below which zebras mark shadows as clipped.

label: Video Profile:
does: Picks the video profile: resolution, frame rate, bitrate, codec.
Sets the playback frame rate of the assembled timelapse video.
notes: Label empty in census; header string is 'Timelapse frame rate'

label: Video Profile Editor
does: Opens the editor to create custom video profiles.

label: Video HDR:
does: Turns on HDR video recording.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2

label: Video Stabilization:
does: Turns video stabilisation on or off.

label: Audio source:
does: Chooses which microphone records the sound for video.

label: Size:
does: Sets the photo resolution.

label: Picture Format:
does: Chooses the file type: JPEG, RAW/DNG, or both.

label: YUV size:
does: Sets the size of the YUV image stream used for capture.

label: Secondary Size:
does: Sets the picture size from the second sensor on dual-camera phones.
notes: Used with Huawei dual-sensor mode (DualCameraModeHuaweiApi2) and raw output selection

label: Physical Camera:
does: Pins capture to one physical lens instead of letting the phone switch automatically.

label: JPEG Quality:
does: Sets JPEG compression quality.

label: MNFR
does: Merges several frames to reduce noise (multi-frame noise reduction).

label: Xiaomi MNFR
does: Xiaomi's multi-frame noise reduction.
notes: Xiaomi only; Camera2 vendor key; same job as MFNR

label: AoV Mode:
does: Turns MediaTek's AOV vendor mode on or off.
notes: MediaTek vendor key; Camera2; description says 'All on Video', key is aovservicefeature (likely Always-On Vision) - purpose unclear

label: Shutter fire interval:
does: Sets the time between shots in interval mode.

label: Interval duration:
does: Sets how long the interval capture keeps running.

label: Raw Flat Field
does: Downloads flat-field correction data to embed in DNG files.

label: Bayer Format:
does: Sets the sensor's raw colour pattern used when writing DNGs.
notes: Fix for devices reporting wrong Bayer order

label: CustomMatrix:
does: Picks a custom colour matrix (DNG profile) for raw files.

label: ToneMapProfile:
does: Picks the tone curve profile written into DNG files.

label: Use GlassCam DngConverter
does: Uses GlassCam's own DNG converter for 16-bit raw.

label: Use custom DNG profile
does: Uses the chosen custom DNG colour profile under Camera2.

label: Raw size:
does: Sets the raw image resolution.

label: API:
does: Chooses which Android camera API the app uses (Camera1 or Camera2).

label: Storage Location:
does: Chooses where photos and videos are saved.

label: Geo-Tag Location
does: Adds GPS location to photos (geotagging).

label: Night overlay:
does: Puts a red overlay over the screen for night use.

label: Touch to Capture
does: Takes a photo when the preview is touched.

label: Play Shutter Sound
does: Plays a sound when a photo is taken.

label: Merge AF bracket into a focus stack
label_it: Unisci il bracketing AF in una pila di fuoco
does: Merges a focus bracket into one focus-stacked JPEG after capture.

label: Save Camera Parameters
does: Saves the camera's parameters to a file for debugging.

label: Open Camera in LegacyMode:
does: Opens the camera in legacy mode for phones that need it.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2

label: Run feature detector
does: Re-runs detection of what this phone's camera supports.

label: Dump vendor keys
does: Dumps the phone's vendor camera keys to a file for debugging.

label: Preview Template:
does: Chooses the capture template used for the live preview.

label: Capture Template:
does: Chooses the capture template used when taking the photo.

label: Hide camera UI
does: Hides all camera controls on screen.

label: Preview PostProcessing:
does: Turns on preview processing needed for focus peaking and the live histogram.

label: Focus-peak colour:
does: Chooses the colour used to highlight sharp areas.

label: Orientation Correction:
does: Rotates the image 180 degrees for phones whose camera is mounted upside down.

label: Swap preview width and height
does: Swaps preview width and height when the preview looks stretched.
notes: Preview fix, not a picture aspect ratio

label: GlassCam AE
does: Uses GlassCam's own automatic exposure instead of the phone's.

label: Max Iso:
does: Sets the highest ISO GlassCam's auto exposure may use.

label: Min Iso:
does: Sets the lowest ISO GlassCam's auto exposure may use.

label: Min ExposureTime:
does: Sets the fastest shutter speed GlassCam's auto exposure may use.

label: Max ExposureTime:
does: Sets the slowest shutter speed GlassCam's auto exposure may use.

label: Grid:
does: Overlays a composition grid on the preview.

label: Image Level:
does: Shows a level to keep the picture straight.

label: Auto-zoom on manual focus
does: Magnifies the preview while focusing by hand.

label: Zoom factor:
does: Sets how much the preview magnifies while focusing by hand.

label: Zoom duration:
does: Sets how long the focus magnification stays on.

label: Force Wide Preview
does: Uses the widest available preview size.

label: Scene:
does: Picks a scene preset (night, sports, portrait...).

label: WB:
does: Picks a white balance preset (auto, daylight, cloudy...).

label: Color Effect:
does: Applies a colour effect (mono, sepia, negative...).

label: Correlated Color Temperature:
does: Sets how the camera corrects colour (auto, manual transform matrix).
notes: Writes CaptureRequest.COLOR_CORRECTION_MODE via WbHandler despite census 'app setting'

label: Tonemap:
does: Sets how the camera maps tones (contrast curve mode).

label: Camera Control:
does: Turns the camera's automatic controls (exposure, focus, white balance) on or off.

label: Red-Eye Reduction:
does: Fires a pre-flash to reduce red eye.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2

label: Anti Flicker:
does: Reduces flicker bands from artificial lights (50/60 Hz).

label: Image Post Processing:
does: Sets the quality of the camera's image post-processing.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: Lens shade:
does: Corrects darker corners (vignetting).

label: Noise reduction:
does: Sets noise reduction for photos.

label: SceneDetection:
does: Lets the camera pick the scene mode automatically.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: Temporal Denoise:
does: Multi-frame temporal noise reduction for photos.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: Temporal Video Denoise:
does: Multi-frame temporal noise reduction for video.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: PDAF Control:
does: Turns phase-detection autofocus on or off.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: True Portrait:
does: Vendor portrait (background blur) effect.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2; description string is 'Description pending'

label: RDI:
does: Raw dump interface for zero-lag raw capture.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: Chroma Flash:
does: Combines flash and no-flash frames for better flash photos.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: Optizoom:
does: Vendor enhanced digital zoom.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2; description says 'Auto track zoom object'

label: Refocus:
does: Vendor refocus: lets focus be changed after the shot.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: StillMore:
does: Vendor local tone mapping to bring out shadows and highlights.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: Virtual Lens Filter:
does: Applies a virtual lens filter effect.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: Digital Image Stabilization:
does: Electronic image stabilisation.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2

label: Memory Color Enhancement:
does: Boosts colours, like a vibrance control.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: Zero Shutter Lag:
does: Zero shutter lag: buffers frames so the photo is taken instantly.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2; must be off for raw

label: HDR Mode:
does: Turns the camera's built-in HDR on or off.
notes: Camera1 only - not shown under Camera2

label: ManualControl(ZSL= OFF):
does: Enables manual controls when zero shutter lag is off.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: Correlated double sampling:
does: Correlated double sampling: reads the sensor twice to reduce noise.
notes: Camera1 only; Qualcomm vendor parameter - not shown under Camera2

label: Edge Mode:
does: Sets edge enhancement (sharpening).

label: Hot Pixel Correction:
does: Sets hot-pixel correction.

label: Distortion Correction:
does: Corrects lens distortion.

label: Face Detection:
does: Turns face detection on or off.

label: Optical Image Stabilisation:
does: Turns optical image stabilisation on or off.

label: Dual Camera:
does: Chooses which sensor(s) of a dual camera to use.

label: Auto Exposure Mode:
does: Sets the automatic exposure mode (on, off, with flash...).

label: AE Frame Range:
does: Sets the frame rate range the auto exposure may use.

label: AE Meter Area:
does: Chooses the area used to measure exposure.

label: info
does: Shows the photo's details (EXIF information).

label: closeView
does: Closes the full-screen view and returns to the gallery.

label: play
does: Plays the selected video.

label: delete
does: Deletes the shown file.

label: EmptyFragment
does: Empty placeholder screen part with no function.

label: HorizontLineFragment
does: The level line drawn over the preview.
notes: Part of the camera screen; shown by HORIZONT_LVL

label: ManualFragment
does: Holder for the manual controls area.

label: NextGenMainFragment
does: Holds the camera screen and the settings pages.

label: HelpFragment
does: Help overlay explaining the controls.

label: NextGenCameraSettingFragment
does: The settings list screen part.

label: NextGenCameraUiFragment
does: The camera controls layer over the preview.

label: NextGenHorizontalValuesFragment
does: Pop-up row of values to pick for a control.

label: NextGenManualsFragment
does: The manual-strip area (ISO, shutter, focus...).

label: NextGenSettingDummyFragment
does: Holds the one list of all settings rows.

label: VideoProfileEditorFragment
does: The content of the video profile editor.

label: DngConvertingFragment
does: The content of the raw-to-DNG converter.

label: GridViewFragment
does: The thumbnail grid of the gallery.

label: ImageFragment
does: Shows one photo full screen in the gallery.

label: ScreenSlideFragment
does: Swipes between photos in full screen.
